source.label: Official Heritage Square menu PDF
source.note: Unofficial demo excerpt, not endorsed by Pizzeria Bianco. This PDF was linked from the official Heritage Square page on the access date. Its filename identifies an April 2023 menu, so these are documented snapshot prices rather than a promise of current prices. Descriptions are condensed paraphrases. Antipasto is served after 4pm. No dietary or allergen claims are inferred.
